description: Decodes and validates an EMV merchant-presented-mode (MPM) QR payload against a pluggable national scheme profile - generic EMV MPM, Fiji FJQR, or Brazil Pix BR Code - covering TLV structure, duplicate and trailing-object detection, the CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE checksum over the payload including the literal 6304 (with a dedicated rule for the common generator bug that excludes it), point-of-initiation static versus dynamic semantics, merchant-account templates 26-51 and their globally unique identifiers, MCC, ISO 4217 currency, amount and tip/convenience consistency, merchant name and city presence and length, additional-data subfield structure, and for Pix dynamic payloads the location-URL shape and the JWS protected-header skeleton (alg allowed set, kid, jku) without any signature verification. Zero network and zero PII echo: merchant name, city, postal, additional-data values and account identifiers are reported as tag/length/verdict only, never echoed; a dynamic payload URL is never fetched. Exclusions: no signature or key verification, no QR image decoding (payload string only), no scheme-operator endorsement implied; the FJQR profile cannot verify scheme-specific account GUIDs because the FJQR technical specification's GUI registry is not public (advisory only).

cited_clause_digest.clause_path: EMV QRCPS Merchant-Presented Mode v1.1 (Nov 2020) sections 4.1-4.11 and Annex B: payload bound, presence, two-digit ID and length, one occurrence per ID, data organization, root data objects (00/01/02-51/52/53/54/55-57/58/59/60/61/62/63/64), merchant account template GUI (4.7.11), CRC per ISO/IEC 13239 polynomial 1021 init FFFF including the CRC ID and length (4.7.3). Public mirror of the EMVCo spec obtainable free at emvco.com/emv-technologies/qr-codes under its license terms; terms permit implementation, restrict reproduction - facts implemented, text not reproduced.

RBF Guidelines on Participation in the Fiji QR Code Scheme (19 May 2026) sections 1.2 (scope: static merchant-presented QR at launch, dynamic expected in future, footnotes 2 and 5), 2.1 and footnote 3 (FJQR built on EMV MPM v1.1), 2.2 definitions (static QR: fixed merchant information, consumer verifies the doing-business-as name and enters the amount; dynamic QR: unique per transaction with amount and unique transaction reference; CA and PKC signing model), 5.1 (merchant name displayed prominently - basis for the name-presence check and the no-echo redaction).

Banco Central do Brasil BR Code Manual v2.0.0 (EN) Table 1 and notes: GUI br.gov.bcb.pix under IDs 26-51 (with 26.00 mandatory), tag 01 value 12 as one-time-use marker, MCC 52 as 0000 or ISO 18245, currency 53 as 986 BRL, country 58 as BR, tag 62 sub-05 transaction identifier mandatory, CRC-16-CCITT with init 0xFFFF; worked 270-character example with published CRC AD38 used as the byte-exact development cross-check.
cited_clause_digest.id: BCB BR Code manual v2.0.0 (EN) Table 1

cited_clause_digest.clause_path: BCB Manual de Padroes para Iniciacao do Pix sections 2.5.2 and 2.7.2: dynamic-QR location URL carried in tag 26 sub-ID 25; location layout fqdn/pixEndpoint/accessToken; no protocol prefix in the QR (HTTPS enforced at access time after validation); maximum 77 characters without prefix; the location returns a JWS compact-serialization envelope per RFC 7515 with content type application/jose.
cited_clause_digest.id: BCB Pix initiation standards (location and JWS envelope)

cited_clause_digest.clause_path: BCB Manual de Seguranca do SFN Vol. II v6.00, Pix JWS JOSE header requirements: alg prohibited values HS* and none, allowed RS256-or-higher and ES256-or-higher, recommended PS256 or PS512; jku (JWK Set URL parameter) and kid (Key ID) header parameters; x5t/x5t#S256 thumbprint option. Shape check only - no signature verification and no key material in this node.
cited_clause_digest.id: BCB SFN security manual Vol II v6.00 (JWS header rules)
